name: Upper trapezius
origin: External occipital protuberance, medial superior nuchal line and nuchal ligament
insertion: Lateral third of the clavicle
action: Scapular elevation and upward rotation (draws scapula superomedially); head/neck extension, ipsilateral side-bending and contralateral rotation
nerve: Accessory nerve (CN XI) (motor) and C3–C4 via cervical plexus
blood: Occipital artery

name: Middle trapezius
origin: Spinous processes and supraspinous ligaments of T1–T4 (or C7–T3)
insertion: Medial acromion and superior crest of the scapular spine
action: Scapular retraction (medial glide)
nerve: Accessory nerve (CN XI) (motor) and C3–C4 via cervical plexus
blood: Superficial or transverse cervical artery

name: Lower trapezius
origin: Spinous processes and supraspinous ligaments of T4–T12
insertion: Medial end (root) of the scapular spine
action: Scapular depression and upward rotation (inferomedial glide)
nerve: Accessory nerve (CN XI) (motor) and C3–C4 via cervical plexus
blood: Dorsal scapular artery

name: Levator scapulae
origin: Transverse processes of C1–C4
insertion: Medial border of the scapula, from superior angle to root of the spine
action: Scapular elevation (draws scapula superomedially) and downward rotation; neck side-bending and extension
nerve: Dorsal scapular nerve (C5) and anterior rami of C3–C4
blood: Transverse cervical and ascending cervical arteries

name: Splenius capitis
origin: Nuchal ligament and spinous processes of C7–T3
insertion: Mastoid process and lateral superior nuchal line
action: Bilateral: head and neck extension; unilateral: ipsilateral rotation and side-bending
blood: Muscular branches of the occipital artery

name: Splenius cervicis
origin: Spinous processes of T3–T6
insertion: Transverse processes of C1–C3
action: Bilateral: neck extension; unilateral: ipsilateral neck rotation and side-bending
nerve: Posterior rami of the lower cervical spinal nerves (lateral branches)
blood: Vertebral, occipital, superior intercostal, deep cervical and transverse cervical arteries

name: Sternocleidomastoid
origin: Manubrium of the sternum (sternal head) and medial third of the clavicle (clavicular head)
insertion: Lateral surface of the mastoid process and lateral half of the superior nuchal line
action: Unilateral: ipsilateral side-bending and contralateral rotation; bilateral: neck flexion, accessory inspiration
nerve: Accessory nerve (CN XI) and cervical plexus branches (C2–C3)
blood: Superior thyroid artery

name: Rhomboid major
origin: Spinous processes of T2–T5
insertion: Medial border of the scapula, from root of the spine to the inferior angle
action: Scapular retraction and elevation (draws scapula superomedially) and downward rotation (glenoid faces inferiorly)
blood: Dorsal scapular artery, deep branch of transverse cervical artery, posterior intercostal arteries

name: Rhomboid minor
origin: Nuchal ligament and spinous processes of C7–T1
insertion: Root (medial end) of the spine of the scapula
action: Scapular retraction and elevation (draws scapula superomedially) and downward rotation (glenoid faces inferiorly)
blood: Dorsal scapular artery, deep branch of transverse cervical artery, posterior intercostal arteries

name: Serratus anterior
origin: Ribs 1–8/9 (sometimes to rib 10) and intercostal fascia
insertion: Anterior (costal) surface of the medial border of the scapula, from superior to inferior angle
action: Scapular protraction and upward rotation; holds the scapula against the thoracic wall
blood: Superior and lateral thoracic arteries, thoracodorsal artery

name: Pectoralis major
origin: Medial half of clavicle, sternum, costal cartilages 1–6 and anterior layer of the rectus sheath
insertion: Lateral lip of the intertubercular (bicipital) groove of the humerus
action: Shoulder adduction and medial rotation; clavicular part flexes, sternocostal part extends the flexed arm
blood: Pectoral branches of thoracoacromial artery, perforating branches of internal thoracic artery

name: Pectoralis minor
origin: Ribs 3–5 (anterior surface, near the costal cartilages)
insertion: Coracoid process of the scapula (medial border and upper surface)
action: Stabilises the scapula against the ribcage (draws it anteroinferiorly)
blood: Thoracoacromial, superior thoracic and lateral thoracic arteries

name: Deltoid
origin: Lateral third of the clavicle, acromion and spine of the scapula
insertion: Deltoid tuberosity of the humerus
action: Anterior: flexion & medial rotation; middle: abduction; posterior: extension & lateral rotation of the shoulder
blood: Thoracoacromial artery branches, anterior and posterior circumflex humeral arteries, subscapular and deep brachial arteries

name: Supraspinatus
origin: Supraspinous fossa of the scapula
insertion: Superior facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus
action: Shoulder abduction (initiates the first ~15°); stabilises the humeral head
blood: Suprascapular artery

insertion: infra
tmin

name: Infraspinatus
origin: Infraspinous fossa of the scapula
insertion: Middle facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus
action: Shoulder lateral rotation; stabilises the humeral head
blood: Suprascapular and circumflex scapular arteries

insertion: supra
tmin
action: tmin

name: Teres minor
origin: Lateral border of the scapula (upper two-thirds)
insertion: Inferior facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus
action: Shoulder lateral rotation and adduction; stabilises the humeral head
blood: Suprascapular and dorsal scapular arteries

insertion: supra
infra
action: infra

name: Subscapularis
origin: Subscapular fossa of the scapula
insertion: Lesser tubercle of the humerus
action: Shoulder medial rotation; stabilises the humeral head
blood: Suprascapular, axillary and subscapular arteries

name: Biceps brachii
origin: Short head: tip of the coracoid process; long head: supraglenoid tubercle
insertion: Radial tuberosity and (via bicipital aponeurosis) deep fascia of the forearm
action: Elbow flexion and forearm supination (assists shoulder flexion)
blood: Branches of the brachial artery

origin: corbr

name: Brachialis
origin: Distal half of the anterior humerus
insertion: Coronoid process and tuberosity of the ulna
action: Elbow flexion in all forearm positions (the 'workhorse' flexor)
blood: Brachial and radial recurrent arteries

name: Coracobrachialis
origin: Coracoid process of the scapula (tip)
insertion: Anteromedial surface of the humeral shaft (middle third)
action: Shoulder flexion and adduction
blood: Muscular branches of the brachial artery

origin: biceps

name: Triceps brachii
origin: Long head: infraglenoid tubercle; lateral head: posterior humerus above the radial groove; medial head: below it
insertion: Olecranon of the ulna and fascia of the forearm
action: Elbow extension (long head also extends the shoulder)
blood: Deep brachial and superior ulnar collateral arteries

name: Brachioradialis
origin: Lateral supracondylar ridge of the humerus and lateral intermuscular septum
insertion: Distal radius, just proximal to the styloid process
action: Elbow flexion, strongest with the forearm in mid-prone (neutral)
blood: Radial, radial recurrent and radial collateral arteries

name: Extensor carpi radialis brevis
origin: Lateral epicondyle of the humerus (common extensor origin)
insertion: Dorsal base of the 3rd metacarpal
action: Wrist extension and radial deviation
blood: Radial recurrent, radial and deep brachial arteries

origin: ecu

name: Extensor carpi ulnaris
origin: Lateral epicondyle (common extensor origin) and posterior border of the ulna
insertion: Base of the 5th metacarpal (medial/dorsal side)
action: Wrist extension and ulnar deviation
blood: Radial recurrent and posterior interosseous arteries

origin: ecrb

name: Extensor carpi radialis longus
origin: Lateral supracondylar ridge of the humerus and lateral intermuscular septum
insertion: Dorsal base of the 2nd metacarpal
action: Wrist extension and radial deviation
blood: Radial recurrent, radial collateral and radial arteries

name: Flexor carpi radialis
origin: Medial epicondyle of the humerus (common flexor origin)
insertion: Palmar bases of the 2nd and 3rd metacarpals
action: Wrist flexion and radial deviation
blood: Ulnar recurrent arteries and radial artery

origin: fcu

name: Flexor carpi ulnaris
origin: Humeral head: medial epicondyle; ulnar head: olecranon and posterior border of ulna
insertion: Pisiform, hook of the hamate and base of the 5th metacarpal
action: Wrist flexion and ulnar deviation
blood: Posterior ulnar recurrent and ulnar arteries

origin: fcr

name: Quadratus lumborum
origin: Iliac crest and iliolumbar ligament
insertion: Inferior border of the 12th rib and transverse processes of L1–L4
action: Unilateral: ipsilateral trunk side-bending (hip hiking); bilateral: lumbar extension; fixes 12th rib in inspiration
nerve: Subcostal nerve (T12) and L1–L4 anterior rami
blood: Lumbar, median sacral, iliolumbar and subcostal arteries

name: Psoas major
origin: Vertebral bodies and discs of T12–L4, transverse processes of L1–L5
insertion: Lesser trochanter of the femur (common iliopsoas tendon)
action: Hip flexion (thigh or trunk); externally rotates the femur; trunk side-bending; stabilises the hip
blood: Lumbar branch of the iliolumbar artery

name: Iliacus
origin: Iliac fossa (also iliac crest, sacral ala and anterior sacroiliac ligaments)
insertion: Lesser trochanter of the femur (common iliopsoas tendon)
action: Hip flexion; stabilises the hip joint
blood: Iliolumbar, deep circumflex iliac, obturator and femoral arteries

name: Gluteus medius
origin: Outer ilium between the anterior and posterior gluteal lines
insertion: Lateral surface of the greater trochanter
action: Hip abduction and medial rotation (anterior fibres); stabilises the pelvis in single-leg stance
blood: Deep branch of superior gluteal artery, trochanteric anastomosis

name: Gluteus minimus
origin: Outer ilium between the anterior and inferior gluteal lines
insertion: Anterior surface of the greater trochanter
action: Hip abduction and medial rotation; stabilises the pelvis
blood: Superior gluteal artery, trochanteric anastomosis

insertion: gmed
pirif
action: gmed

name: Gluteus maximus
origin: Posterior ilium (behind posterior gluteal line), dorsal sacrum and coccyx, sacrotuberous ligament, thoracolumbar fascia
insertion: Iliotibial tract and gluteal tuberosity of the femur
action: Hip extension and lateral rotation
blood: Inferior and superior gluteal arteries

name: Tensor fasciae latae
origin: Anterior superior iliac spine (ASIS) and anterior outer iliac crest
insertion: Iliotibial tract → lateral condyle of the tibia (Gerdy's tubercle)
action: Hip flexion, abduction and medial rotation; tenses the iliotibial band
blood: Ascending branch of the lateral circumflex femoral artery

name: Piriformis
origin: Anterior surface of the sacrum (S2–S4), ilium near the PIIS and sacrotuberous ligament
insertion: Apex (superior border) of the greater trochanter
action: Hip lateral rotation of the extended hip; abducts the flexed hip
blood: Superior and inferior gluteal arteries, internal pudendal artery branches

action: Knee flexion and lateral rotation of the flexed knee; long head extends and laterally rotates the hip

blood: Inferior gluteal, perforating and popliteal arteries

action: Hip adduction; adductor part flexes, hamstring part extends the hip

name: Rectus femoris
origin: Anterior inferior iliac spine (AIIS) and supra-acetabular groove
insertion: Tibial tuberosity (via patellar ligament) and patella
action: Knee extension and hip flexion
blood: Femoral, lateral circumflex femoral and superficial circumflex iliac arteries

name: Vastus lateralis
origin: Intertrochanteric line, greater trochanter, gluteal tuberosity and lateral lip of the linea aspera
insertion: Tibial tuberosity (via patellar ligament) and patella
action: Knee extension
blood: Lateral circumflex femoral and deep femoral arteries

origin: vm

name: Vastus medialis
origin: Intertrochanteric line, pectineal line, medial lip of linea aspera and medial supracondylar line
insertion: Tibial tuberosity (via patellar ligament) and patella
action: Knee extension; medial stabilisation of the patella (VMO)
blood: Femoral, deep femoral and descending genicular arteries

origin: vl

origin: Anterior (and lateral) surface of the femoral shaft
insertion: Tibial tuberosity (via patellar ligament) and patella

name: Gastrocnemius

name: Tibialis posterior

insertion: Navicular tuberosity, cuneiforms, cuboid and bases of metatarsals 2–4
